# ── Password Policy Audit ───────────────────────────────
# Module 2: Risk Management
# Standard: NIST SP 800-63B (Digital Identity Guidelines)

# Hospital staff accounts (username, password)
staff_accounts = [
    ("dr.patel",       "hospital123"),
    ("nurse.ahmed",    "Meridian2024!"),
    ("admin.chen",     "qwerty"),
    ("it.torres",      "X#9mK@pL2$vQ"),
    ("dr.kim",         "password"),
    ("receptionist",   "Summer2024"),
    ("cfo.williams",   "P@ssw0rd!"),
    ("lab.rodriguez",  "Secure#Lab99"),
    ("security.jones", "letmein"),
    ("cto.nakamura",   "Tr0ub4dor&3"),
]

# Known-breached passwords (HaveIBeenPwned top list)
breach_list = ["hospital123", "qwerty", "password", "letmein",
               "123456", "admin", "welcome", "monkey", "sunshine"]

def audit_password(username, password):
    """Assess password strength against NIST SP 800-63B rules."""
    issues = []
    score = 0

    # Rule 1: Minimum length
    if len(password) >= 12:
        score += 3
    elif len(password) >= 8:
        score += 1
    else:
        issues.append("Too short (<8 chars)")

    # Rule 2: Not a known-breached password
    if password.lower() in breach_list:
        score = 0
        issues.append("BREACHED: found in known password list")

    # Rule 3: Complexity (uppercase, lowercase, digits, special chars)
    import re
    if re.search(r'[A-Z]', password):  score += 1
    if re.search(r'[a-z]', password):  score += 1
    if re.search(r'[0-9]', password):  score += 1
    if re.search(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', password): score += 2

    strength = (
        "CRITICAL" if score <= 1 else
        "WEAK"     if score <= 3 else
        "FAIR"     if score <= 5 else
        "STRONG"
    )
    return {"username": username, "password": password,
            "score": score, "strength": strength, "issues": issues}
